description: This file defines the main activity class for an Android application that demonstrates app usage statistics. It extends ActionBarActivity, sets up the activity's layout, and initializes a fragment to display the statistics.

classes.name: AppUsageStatisticsActivity
classes.description: Main launcher activity that initializes the user interface and the app usage statistics fragment.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the Activity's onCreate method to set up the layout and initialize the fragment displaying app usage statistics.
